meta.note: State SC corporation district offices. Compiled 5 September 2026 from the corporations' own contact pages. Every row carries its source URL. Fields prefixed with _ are provenance documentation, not database columns. Address is null where the corporation publishes none - that absence is itself a finding: 6 of 12 offices here have no published postal address, and Karnataka's ADCL publishes none for any office including its own head office.
meta.coordinates: lat/lon are null until manually geocoded from the published address. Offices without an address cannot be geocoded at all.
